title: MEGACO: Pass a tvb subset into dissect_megaco_descriptors
description:
This will naturally terminate the various find commands, so we won't
need some checks for if we found something outside the descriptors
end offset. This doesn't use the new tvb_find_ functions yet, so it
could be backported. We might want to use those in the future to
simplify the checks for offset -1.

Coverity CIDs 1604264 and 1676261
